name: Miyaji Mitsushige
source: One of the chiefs who supervise the Kiko in the back side of Oniwaban along with Kyoushirou. A colleague of Kyoushirou and Kiyohito who acts as the mediator between Yoichi and Genjuurou, who has jurisdiction over Zyouka. Due to his gentle nature, he sometimes can be indecisive but is compassionate and cares about his colleagues.
